applicability: Alberta government (Public Works Act) contracts are outside the PPCLA payment timelines (alberta.ca prompt-payment page).
Contracts that pre-date the Aug 29, 2022 start of the new rules may follow the old Act (alberta.ca prompt-payment page).
Contracts/procurements that started before July 1, 2018 stay under the old Act (Construction Act s.87.3(1)).
Prompt-payment and adjudication Parts do not apply to contracts entered into before Oct 1, 2019 (Construction Act s.87.3(4)).
